name: jobscrape
description: Self-hosted job scraping platform: pluggable adapters for ATS APIs, job boards and generic career pages, with normalization, dedup, scheduling and a REST API.

scripts.setup:scrapling: python3 -m venv scrapling/.venv && scrapling/.venv/bin/pip install -q "scrapling[fetchers]" && scrapling/.venv/bin/scrapling install
